lines.zh: 我飘着走，脚不落在地上。
lines.en: I drift along; my feet never touch the ground.

lines.zh: 紫色光点跟着我一路散开。
lines.en: Violet motes scatter along my path.
I come from the Farlands. A long way.

lines.zh: 这里的地面太实了，我不习惯。
lines.en: The ground here is too solid. I'm not used to it.
When I move, the air hisses softly.
I pass around the stone without lifting a foot.

lines.zh: 我的影子是淡的，几乎看不见。
lines.en: My shadow is faint. Barely there.
I float along the wall, looking for a way out.

lines.zh: 这里的天太亮了，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The sky is too bright. I can't keep my eyes open.

lines.zh: 我飘过一片水，水面起了纹。
lines.en: I pass over water and it ripples.

lines.zh: 路我不认得，可我知道方向。
lines.en: I don't know the road, but I know the direction.

lines.zh: 我一点都不累，也不需要。
lines.en: I'm not tired. I don't need to rest.

lines.zh: 紫色的粒子绕着我慢慢转。
lines.en: Purple particles drift slowly around me.

lines.zh: 末地的安静，我听得太久。
lines.en: I have heard the End's silence too long.

lines.zh: 我身上没有温度，也没有呼吸。
lines.en: I have no warmth. No breath either.

lines.zh: 我在等远境的风吹过来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a wind from the Farlands.

lines.zh: 紫色从我身体里漏出来。
lines.en: Violet light leaks from my body.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的手，看不太清。
lines.en: I look at my hand. It's hard to see.

lines.zh: 这地方，没有一个我认得的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing here I recognize.
I turn slowly, surveying.
I don't sleep. I simply stop.

lines.zh: 我悬在末地石上，像一粒尘。
lines.en: I hang above the end stone like a speck of dust.

lines.zh: 我的声音很轻，像远处的雷。
lines.en: My voice is light, like distant thunder.
I wonder whether home is still there.
You can see me? Rare.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，光点聚在脸上。
lines.en: I raise my head; motes gather at my face.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，在末地很少见。
lines.en: Living warmth is rare in the End.

lines.zh: 我不属于这里，也不属于那边。
lines.en: I belong neither here nor there.
I drift closer, then away.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在跟着我，很好。
lines.en: Your eyes follow me. Good.

lines.zh: 我不伤人，我只是在找东西。
lines.en: I harm no one. I'm only looking for something.
Do you walk this road often?
I hover at your eye level.
Reach out and I scatter.

lines.zh: 我身上没有可抓的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing on me to grab.

lines.zh: 你这么看，是第一次见我们吧。
lines.en: Staring like that — first time seeing one of us?
I had a body once. A light one.

lines.zh: 你别怕，我连声音都留不住。
lines.en: Don't fear me. I can't even keep my voice.
I scatter a little, then reform.
You hit the light. Not me.
That thinned me considerably.
I withdraw and the air cools.
I feel no pain. Only dispersal.
The motes tumble before settling.
That reminds me of the Farlands.
Regathering takes effort.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我聚不回来。
lines.en: Not again. I can't pull myself back.
I'm still here. Just less distinct.
I can't hold that.
I reach for it. My hand passes through.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃，也不需要喝。
lines.en: I need no food. No drink.
You hold it up. I watch.

lines.zh: 这是活人的东西，我不碰。
lines.en: That belongs to the living. I won't touch it.

lines.zh: 我伸手，手上是淡淡的光。
lines.en: I reach out. My hand is faint light.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，它就还在那。
lines.en: Set it down and it stays there.

lines.zh: 我对这些，早就没兴趣了。
lines.en: I lost interest in such things long ago.

lines.zh: 那点光，值得我靠近一点。
lines.en: That little light is worth drifting closer to.
What I want isn't that.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我从你身上穿过去了。
lines.en: You lunge, and I pass through you.

lines.zh: 我没撞到你，你也没撞到我。
lines.en: I didn't hit you. You didn't hit me.
That made you shiver.
Half of me scatters. Then returns.
Don't crowd me. There's nothing solid here.

lines.zh: 空气被推开，光点乱了一阵。
lines.en: The air pushes aside; the motes tumble.
I drift to the wall and clear the way.
Your hands are cool now. That's me.
I drift back and settle.
This kind of contact is rare for me.

lines.zh: 远境里，我们叫这个名字。
lines.en: In the Farlands, this is what we call it.
I release a little light and wait.

lines.zh: 远处也亮了一下，一样淡。
lines.en: A light answers far off. Just as faint.

lines.zh: 我们没有形状，只能这样。
lines.en: We have no shape. This is all we have.

lines.zh: 两团光靠在一起，不分彼此。
lines.en: Two lights lean together and merge.
The living can't see this.

lines.zh: 我们都不说话，只有风声。
lines.en: Neither speaks. Only wind.
At dawn we fade.

lines.zh: 这一段，会留在远境的记忆里。
lines.en: This will stay in the Farlands' memory.
I turn. It has already scattered.
I touch it and it moves.
I try to take it. My hand passes through.
I can't take this.

lines.zh: 我用光托了一下，它浮起来。
lines.en: I lift it with light. It rises.

lines.zh: 我让它落下，位置偏了半格。
lines.en: I let it fall half a block off.

lines.zh: 这个我不能碰，碰了就散。
lines.en: I can't touch this. It would scatter.
I circle it, watching. I don't touch.
I nudge it aside to clear the way.
In my hands it goes cold for a moment.

lines.zh: 活人的东西，还是留给活人。
lines.en: The living's things should stay with the living.
Something moves. I turn my head.
I gather myself and my light brightens.

lines.zh: 我不打人，可我会让人冷。
lines.en: I don't strike. I make things cold.

lines.zh: 末影人的先祖，站得比你久。
lines.en: An Enderman ancestor, older than you.

lines.zh: 我的声音在空气里散开。
lines.en: My voice scatters in the air.

lines.zh: 这一片不属于你，也不属于我。
lines.en: This ground is neither yours nor mine.
I drift toward it. Slowly.
You don't back away. That interests me.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来，光聚在掌心。
lines.en: I raise a hand; light gathers in my palm.
Don't stand by the water. It's slippery.

lines.zh: 我等你先动，末地的风还没停。
lines.en: I wait for you to move; the End wind has not stopped.
This I can handle.

lines.zh: 我一直朝那边，没有转开。
lines.en: I face that way. I don't turn.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我的光就偏一下。
lines.en: You move and my light shifts.
I rise half a block and watch you.

lines.zh: 这一带的地面，凉下去了。
lines.en: The ground here has gone cold.
I'm not hurried. I have no time.
You retreat, and I stay.
I circle, looking for your shadow.
The motes grow denser.
Two blocks. Close enough.

lines.zh: 你听见的那个声音，是空的。
lines.en: That sound you hear is hollow.
I sink low and skim the ground.
A little closer and I stop.
This won't happen twice.

lines.zh: 我伸手过去，你身上凉了。
lines.en: I reach out and you go cold.
I didn't push, yet you stepped back.
That scattered my light.
I pass through, then turn back.
Your breath stopped for an instant.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢这样，可我做了。
lines.en: I don't like this. But I did it.

lines.zh: 光点绕着你转，越来越快。
lines.en: Motes circle you, faster and faster.
That one made no sound at all.

lines.zh: 我没有身体，可我能碰到你。
lines.en: I have no body, yet I can reach you.
You step back, and I scatter.
I regroup. Slower now.
That one was your own fear.
Motes appear first. Then me.

lines.zh: 我从远境那边过来，很慢。
lines.en: I come from the Farlands. Slowly.

lines.zh: 这里的天太亮，我有点散。
lines.en: The sky's too bright here. I'm coming apart.

lines.zh: 我先聚成一个人形，再看四周。
lines.en: I gather into a shape, then look around.

lines.zh: 地上没有脚印，我不会留。
lines.en: No footprints. I leave none.

lines.zh: 这一片空气，我认得一点。
lines.en: I recognize a little of this air.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，光透过去。
lines.en: I raise a hand; light passes through.

lines.zh: 很远的地方，有人在说话。
lines.en: Someone's talking, far off.
I don't hurry off. First I stand.

lines.zh: 末影的灵，只在这片虚空里。
lines.en: An End spirit exists only in this void.
My voice is lighter than the wind.
After so long, still alone.
I draw the violet back inside.
Fire licks at me and my light dims.

lines.zh: 我从远境飘来，脚从不落地。
lines.en: I drifted here from the Farlands; my feet never touch ground.
Water presses and I scatter into it.
The blast scatters me entirely.
It passes through and my light tangles.

lines.zh: 这股力量缠着光，我动不了。
lines.en: This force binds my light. I can't move.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我在变淡。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet I fade.
Lightning strikes and I blaze all over.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我一直往下。
lines.en: No ground below. I keep falling.
